# Pull request template

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.vi.md)

## Scope
Describe exactly what changed and why.

## Validation
- [ ] CPU pytest PASS
- [ ] Browser E2E PASS (if UI affected)
- [ ] Evidence updated only if newly reproduced
- [ ] Model license separation and no credentials
- [ ] EN/VI documentation paired
- [ ] Source code diff approximately <=600 lines or justified

## Proof
Add commands, check summaries, and relevant SHA256.
